roadmap.title: Constantinople story campaign
roadmap.description: Play DNA Sequences 1-9 to the ending while clearing each memory's optional objective for 100% sync and picking up the story-linked unlocks (den defense, early story counters).

roadmap.title: Constantinople open world and side content
roadmap.description: Collect the 100 data fragments and 28 books, clear the Hagia Sofia tomb, Piri Reis bomb missions, guild challenges, Master Assassin training, Mediterranean Defense, and the combat and looting counters.

roadmap.title: Desmond's Journey
roadmap.description: Restore the files removed by the multiplayer shutdown, gather 30 data fragments, then complete all five block-platforming Desmond sequences on Animus Island.

roadmap.title: The Lost Archive DLC
roadmap.description: Restore the DLC files, then clear Memories 1-7 including the no-death runs, collect all 20 Decipher Fragments, and finish the Backdoor loop.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Desmond Sequence 1} on @loc{Animus Island}.

guide.context: Desmond's Journey needs files that a Steam update removed. In the Steam console (`steam://nav/console`) run `download_depot 201870 201871 3788743185036498953`, copy the files from the downloaded `depot_201871` folder into the game folder, then delete `systemdetection.dll`. The five sequences unlock at 30 collected @item{Animus data fragments}, or immediately if The Lost Archive DLC is installed.

steps.text: Collect at least 30 @item{Animus data fragments} in @loc{Constantinople}.
On @loc{Animus Island}, go up the hill across from the @loc{Constantinople} gateway and enter the first of the five monoliths.
Finish @mechanic{Desmond Sequence 1}; the achievement unlocks when you return to the island.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 1}.

steps.text: Play the five @loc{Masyaf} memories and kill the Templar Captain to finish @mechanic{DNA Sequence 1}.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Desmond Sequence 2} on @loc{Animus Island}.

guide.context: The five sequences unlock at 30 collected @item{Animus data fragments}, or immediately if The Lost Archive DLC is installed.

steps.text: Enter the second monolith on the @loc{Animus Island} hill.
Clear the sequence, which is shorter but harder than the first, and wait for the return to the island.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 2}.

steps.text: Finish the @loc{Constantinople} memories by killing the Templar Captain in the Imperial District and lighting the signal fire at the Den tower.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Desmond Sequence 3} on @loc{Animus Island}.

guide.context: The five sequences unlock at 30 collected @item{Animus data fragments}, or immediately if The Lost Archive DLC is installed.

steps.text: Enter the third monolith on the @loc{Animus Island} hill.
Clear the sequence and wait for the return to the island.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 3}.

steps.text: Play through Sequence 3, ending with the Master Assassin mission at the @loc{Galata harbor}.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 4}.

steps.text: Finish the Altaïr memory: burn the body, disarm seven Assassins, dodge the Apple blasts, and climb to Abbas.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 5}.

steps.text: Finish the sequence's final Altaïr memory at the @loc{Assassin's HQ}.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 6}.

steps.text: Destroy the Great Chain, clear the harbor with the Greek Fire cannon, and board your ship to @loc{Cappadocia}.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Desmond Sequence 4} on @loc{Animus Island}.

guide.context: The five sequences unlock at 30 collected @item{Animus data fragments}, or immediately if The Lost Archive DLC is installed.

steps.text: Enter the fourth monolith on the @loc{Animus Island} hill.
Clear the sequence and wait for the return to the island.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 7}.

steps.text: Kill Manuel in @loc{Cappadocia}, then finish the Altaïr memory to close the sequence.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 8}.

steps.text: Finish the short sequence; it ends when Sofia is safe and the stolen item is recovered.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Desmond Sequence 5} on @loc{Animus Island}.

guide.context: The five sequences unlock at 30 collected @item{Animus data fragments}, or immediately if The Lost Archive DLC is installed.

steps.text: Enter the fifth monolith on the @loc{Animus Island} hill.
Clear the sequence and wait for the return to the island.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{DNA Sequence 9}.

guide.context: The ending credits that follow run about 10-15 minutes and cannot be skipped.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Masyaf} library, place the keys, and watch the ending.

achievements.summary: Reach 100% synchronization in all nine story sequences.

guide.context: Only the nine story sequences count; secret locations, HQ missions, and challenges do not. Every memory can be replayed from the DNA tab, which also shows each sequence's percentage.

steps.text: Complete each memory's optional objective as you play the story; the objectives are shown when the memory starts.
After the story, open DNA and check every sequence's completion percentage.
Replay any memory that is not at 100% and clear its optional objective again.

achievements.description: Complete the Hagia Sofia challenge level.
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Hagia Sofia} challenge level.

guide.context: The tomb opens once all 10 @item{Ishak Pasha memoir pages} are collected, which needs story progress into Sequence 5; nine pages are in @loc{Constantinople} and the last is in the @loc{Arsenal District}. After 25 @item{Animus data fragments} a memoir map is sold at book shops for about 10,264 Akçe.

steps.text: Collect all 10 @item{Ishak Pasha memoir pages}.
Enter the marked hidden tomb inside @loc{Hagia Sofia} and clear it.
steps.note: The tomb's optional objective is not required.

achievements.summary: Collect all 100 @item{Animus data fragments}.

guide.context: After 50 fragments the remaining locations are marked on the world map. The last ones are in the @loc{Arsenal District}, which opens in Sequence 5, and @loc{Cappadocia} in Sequence 7.

steps.text: Grab fragments as you play; holding eagle vision makes them easy to spot.
After 50 fragments, follow the map markers to the rest.
Track your total under DNA > Additional Memories.

achievements.summary: Complete all eight @npc{Piri Reis} bomb missions.

guide.context: The missions start from the four paintings in Piri Reis' shop at the @loc{Grand Bazaar} once bombs are taught in Sequence 3. Each painting holds two missions, and finishing the first opens the second.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Piri Reis} at his shop in the @loc{Grand Bazaar}, Imperial District.

Complete the eight tutorials: @mechanic{Datura}, @mechanic{Thunder}, @mechanic{Smoke Screen}, @mechanic{Caltrops}, then @mechanic{Smoke Decoy}, @mechanic{Cherry}, @mechanic{Sticky Situations}, and @mechanic{Tripwire}.
Return to the paintings after each mission; the achievement unlocks when all eight are done.
steps.note: Mission optional objectives are not required.

achievements.description: Control all cities (except Rhodes) simultaneously in the Mediterranian Defense game.
achievements.summary: Control all 12 cities except @loc{Rhodes} at the same time in Mediterranean Defense.

guide.context: Cities are taken with @mechanic{Reclaim The City} contracts once repeated contracts lower Templar control, and they stay yours while Assassin Control stays above 30. Open the map from a den, a board next to a bomb-crafting station, or the @loc{Assassin's HQ}.

steps.text: Send assassins on contracts to weaken every city you do not control.
Reclaim each city until you hold all 12 at once.
Top up Assassin Control on your cities so the Templars cannot retake them.

achievements.description: Perform a perfect den defense without using the cannon.
achievements.summary: Finish a den defense with no damage and no cannon shots.

guide.context: Replay @mechanic{DNA Sequence 2 - Memory 6} for the easiest den defense. The cannon fires with LB or LT, and any damage to the den voids the attempt.

steps.text: Start Memory 6 and place barricades across the approach.
Put your leader at the back and station crossbowmen and riflemen on the rooftops.
Repair barricades as they break and clear all 19 waves, including the final battering ram, without touching the cannon.

achievements.description: Climb Hagia Sofia, from the ground to the pinnacle, in under 25 seconds.
achievements.summary: Scale @loc{Hagia Sofia} from ground level to its pinnacle within 25 seconds.

guide.context: Wait until you have the hookblade from Sequence 2, and start from the courtyard at the front of the building.

steps.text: Stand in the courtyard in front of @loc{Hagia Sofia} and begin the climb.
Sprint the roof tiers and use hookblade grabs to pull over ledges.
Stand on the small pinnacle at the top before the 25 seconds run out.

achievements.description: Complete all Faction Creed Challenges from a single faction.
achievements.summary: Complete every challenge for one faction.

guide.context: The Assassin's Guild has seven challenges and the least busywork; its final set fills up alongside @mechanic{The Mentor} progress.

steps.text: Call assassins during fights 25 times and on targets 20 times.
Use Arrow Storm 15 times and call assassins during five story missions.
Recruit 12 assassins, train seven to Master Assassin, and win three den defenses; replaying Sequence 2 - Memory 6 counts.

achievements.description: Get your money back from a Templar tax collector.
achievements.summary: Take back your money from a Templar tax collector.

guide.context: The collector only roams with a red purse icon above his head while a bank deposit is waiting. Do not kill him; tackle or knock him down to take the money back.

steps.text: Leave a bank deposit unwithdrawn and wait by the Arsenal District gate near the bank next to the Mercenary HQ in south @loc{Bayezid}.
When the red purse marker appears, sneak up and tackle or leg-sweep the collector.
If he escapes, keep the deposit unclaimed and wait for another spawn.

achievements.description: Have seven trainees reach the rank of Master Assassin.
achievements.summary: Promote seven of your recruits to Master Assassin.

guide.context: A den leader's XP caps at level 14 until their part 1 mission is complete, then reaches 15 for the promotion in part 2. Dens led by a Master Assassin can no longer be attacked.

steps.text: Level recruits through Mediterranean Defense contracts and assign a level 10 recruit to each of the seven dens.
Complete each den's part 1 Master Assassin mission.
Keep leveling each leader to 15, then finish their part 2 mission to promote them.
Repeat until seven leaders are Master Assassins.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards in 5 seconds using only your hidden blades.
achievements.summary: Kill five guards within five seconds using only the hidden blade.

guide.context: Assassinations take over a second, so chain double assassinations from a stunned group instead of single kills.

steps.text: Go to the courtyard of @loc{Fatih Camii} in the northwest @loc{Constantine District}, where eight guards patrol.
Group the guards with a cherry bomb, then stun them with a smoke bomb.
Drop in and double-assassinate the nearest pairs: two, then two, then the last guard.

achievements.description: Assassinate 50 guards with the hidden blade.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 guards with hidden blade assassinations.

guide.context: Only stealth assassinations count; killing the same guards in open combat does not.

steps.text: Assassinate unaware guards with the hidden blade as you play, including from behind, from hiding spots, and while blended.

achievements.summary: Land a parachute on a zipline.

guide.context: Buy parachutes from any tailor first, and pick a long zipline.

steps.text: Climb to the beam where the zipline is anchored.
Jump toward the line and open the parachute immediately.
steps.note: Do not look down at the line or you will grab it right away.

steps.text: Release the parachute above the zipline and hold the grab button to catch the line.

achievements.summary: Collect all 28 books.

guide.context: Ten books come from Marco Polo book quests; the other 18 are sold at book shops, with new batches unlocked by story progress and four more sold in @loc{Cappadocia}. The final four cost 65,780 / 84,123 / 94,875 / 107,525 Akçe, so keep owned shops paying out.

steps.text: Buy every book shop's stock as new batches appear with story progress.
Complete the ten book quests, marked by book-shop icons with a dark border, using eagle sense to find the symbols.
Buy the last four books in @loc{Cappadocia}.
steps.note: If you are short on Akçe, replay Sequence 7 - Memory 2 later to shop there again.

achievements.description: Loot 50 dead guards with thief looting.
achievements.summary: Loot 50 dead guards using thief looting.

guide.context: Thief looting unlocks with Thieves Guild Set 2: 40 leaps of faith, a 1 km climb, and 250 Akçe stolen with counter steals. Counter steal only works on militia guards.

steps.text: Complete the Thieves Guild Set 2 challenges to unlock thief looting.
Hire thieves at the Thieves' HQ or faction buildings.
Kill guards around your thieves so they loot each body, until 50 are looted.

achievements.description: Have 10 guards poisoned at the same time.
achievements.summary: Poison 10 guards simultaneously.

guide.context: British gunpowder gives a bomb the widest radius, and datura powder adds the poison effect.

steps.text: Craft a datura bomb with an Impact Shell, British Gunpowder, and Datura Powder.
At the @loc{Fatih Camii} courtyard in the @loc{Constantine District}, gather the guards and any newcomers with cherry bombs.
Throw the datura bomb into the cluster so at least 10 guards are poisoned together.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards with a scaffold after they have been stunned by caltrops.
achievements.summary: Kill five guards with a scaffold after stunning them with caltrops.

guide.context: The five kills are cumulative across attempts and scaffolds. Caltrop bombs are sold by black market dealers.

steps.text: Pick a destructible scaffold; three sit at the Janissary encampment near @loc{Fatih Camii}.
Lure guards against the scaffold and throw a caltrop bomb so they hop in place.
Pull the scaffold down while holding RT, or throw a guard into it.
Repeat until five guards have died to scaffolds.

achievements.summary: Craft 30 bombs.

guide.context: Some players' counters miss crafts; if 30 do not unlock it, keep crafting. Bomb crafting is taught in Sequence 3 - Memory 4.

steps.text: Open the crafting menu at any crafting station and craft a bomb.
Dismantle the bomb to recover the ingredients.
Repeat the craft-and-dismantle loop until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Have one trainee reach the rank of Master Assassin.
achievements.summary: Train one recruit to the rank of Master Assassin.

guide.context: This uses the same process as The Mentor, and the first den leader completes it along the way.

steps.text: Level a recruit to 10 with Mediterranean Defense contracts and assign them to a den.
Complete that den's part 1 Master Assassin mission.
Level the leader to 15 and finish part 2 to promote them.

achievements.description: Parachute directly from the top of the Galata Tower to the golden horn.
achievements.summary: Glide from the peak of @loc{Galata Tower} to the @loc{Golden Horn} using a parachute.

guide.context: The Golden Horn is the water between @loc{Galata} and the rest of @loc{Constantinople}. Buy parachutes from a tailor first.

steps.text: Climb to the very top of @loc{Galata Tower}.
Face the water, jump, and open the parachute immediately.
steps.note: Avoid the leap of faith points or the jump ends in a haystack.

steps.text: Glide until you land in the water with the parachute still open.

achievements.description: Kill three guards simultaneously with only throwing knives.
achievements.summary: Kill three guards at once with throwing knives.

guide.context: All three must die in one hit, so target guards with no armor or light armor.

steps.text: Replay @mechanic{DNA Sequence 1 - Memory 5}; the opening fight puts three soldiers in front of you.
Equip throwing knives and hold the throw button until all three are highlighted.
Release to throw the knives and kill the group together.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards while under the cover of a smoke screen bomb.
achievements.summary: Kill five guards while under a smoke screen.

guide.context: The kills are cumulative across smoke clouds, and any weapon works while the smoke covers you.

steps.text: Craft a smoke screen bomb with an Impact Shell, British Gunpowder, and Phosphorus.
At @loc{Fatih Camii} or the Janissary encampment northeast of it, group enemies with a diversion bomb.
Pop the smoke on the group and kill five guards before it clears.

achievements.description: Have a guard incapacitate 3 civilians while he's poisoned.
achievements.summary: Have a poisoned guard knock out three civilians.

guide.context: Poison makes a guard go berserk and swing at nearby people, and money draws a crowd close to him.

steps.text: Find a guard patrolling a busy market area.
Poison him with the poison blade or a poison dart.
Throw money at his feet so civilians crowd around him.
Wait for him to knock down three civilians.

achievements.summary: Knock out @npc{Duccio} with your fists.

guide.context: @npc{Duccio} appears after Sequence 4 - Memory 3 and waits in the @loc{Constantine District}.

steps.text: Go to the well by the Northwestern Blacksmith, just north of the @loc{Romani Headquarters}; a red enemy marker must appear as you approach.
If he is not there, fast travel away and back until the red marker shows.
Equip your fists and knock him out.

achievements.description: Take the induction leap of faith
achievements.summary: Take the induction leap of faith in The Lost Archive.

guide.context: Requires The Lost Archive DLC and the files a Steam update removed. In the Steam console (`steam://nav/console`) run `download_depot 201870 201871 3788743185036498953`, copy the downloaded `depot_201871` files into the game folder, repeat with `download_depot 201870 201882 6947412385247558407`, then delete `systemdetection.dll`. The DLC was delisted, but a Gold Edition key activated on Ubisoft Connect still unlocks it and syncs achievements.

steps.text: Load The Lost Archive from the main menu and play Memory 2.
Back at the large Assassin tablet, drop through the hole in the floor to take the leap of faith.

achievements.summary: Reach the Animus memo in The Lost Archive.

guide.context: The memo is a story pickup in Memory 3.

steps.text: Unlock Impulse Blocks in Memory 3.
Use them to leave the anti-block chamber and pick up the letter straight ahead.

achievements.summary: Enter the Animus simulation in The Lost Archive.

steps.text: In Memory 4, pass through the Gravity Field corridor.
Drop into the floor where the Animus stands in the Subject Testing Room.
steps.note: From here, every death voids Impress Warren Vidic until you restart the memory.

achievements.summary: Get through Memory 5 of The Lost Archive.

steps.text: Pass through the gateways at the end of Memory 5, Bleeding Effect.

achievements.summary: Complete Memory 7 of The Lost Archive.

steps.text: After traveling through Eden, use an Impulse Block to leap through the ceiling hole and approach the Gateway.

achievements.description: Find all of the decipher fragments
achievements.summary: Find all 20 Decipher Fragments in The Lost Archive.

guide.context: The fragments are spread across the memories: 1 in Memory 1, 4 in Memory 2, 3 in Memory 3, 4 in Memory 4, 4 in Memory 6, and 4 in Memory 7. Collected fragments stay collected after a restart.

steps.text: Collect every fragment as you play, checking ceilings, alcoves, and spots behind pillars.
Check the DLC memory select to see which memories still hold fragments.

achievements.description: Break the loop, escape the cycle
achievements.summary: Escape the loop through the backdoor in The Lost Archive.

guide.context: The backdoor only appears with all 20 Decipher Fragments collected and Memory 7 finished.

steps.text: Finish Memory 7 after collecting all 20 Decipher Fragments.
Replay Memory 5 and play through to its end.
Cross the golden bridge of fragments to the Gateway.

achievements.description: Land on a block after falling more than 25 meters
achievements.summary: Land on a created block after falling more than 25 meters in The Lost Archive.

guide.context: Do this right after the block-creating ability is granted in Memory 1.

steps.text: Build height with wedge blocks on the platform where the ability was granted.
Step off and free-fall, then place a platform block under you just before the ground.
Land on the block; step off afterwards to respawn.

achievements.description: Complete the Animus testing sequence without failing
achievements.summary: Complete the Animus testing sequence in The Lost Archive without dying.

guide.context: Deaths before dropping into the Animus do not count, but any death after voids the run until you restart Memory 4. This is the hardest unlock in the game.

steps.text: Reach the Animus in Memory 4 and drop in.
Clear the laser rooms, the gravity elevator, and the yellow-laser wall without being hit.
Learn the final deletion-square shaft with practice runs, then make a clean run to the bottom.

achievements.description: Make it across the river Styx without failing
achievements.summary: Cross the River Styx in The Lost Archive without dying.

guide.context: A death on the crossing means restarting Memory 7, so practice runs are faster than repeated restarts.

steps.text: Reach the River Styx in Memory 7.
Cross every gap with platform and impulse blocks without falling.
